name: Chin strap while sleeping
lead: A chin strap worn during sleep is a band that holds the mouth closed overnight. In looksmaxxing communities it is discussed as a way to encourage nasal breathing and a closed-mouth resting posture, sometimes alongside mewing or mouth taping.

Reference sources note that chronic mouth breathing in children is associated with dental and facial changes such as a long, narrow face, and that the health effects of mouth taping have been little researched.[1] No trial located for this entry has tested chin straps for appearance.

paras: The strap wraps under the jaw and over the head to keep the lower jaw from dropping open. Believers say this trains nasal breathing and jaw posture.

Mouth breathing is most often an adaptation to nasal congestion, and descriptions recommend treating the underlying cause.[1] Mewing, a related oral-posture practice, is described as unproven; the American Association of Orthodontists says there is no evidence it improves the jaw.[3]
In obstructive sleep apnea, positional and dental-appliance approaches are described; the overview consulted does not address chin straps.[2]

card.summary: A strap to keep the mouth shut overnight; no evidence it reshapes the face.
card.note: Not studied for appearance; nasal obstruction causes of mouth breathing are medical matters.

quick.overview:
A chin strap holds the mouth closed during sleep. Followers say it promotes nasal breathing and better jaw posture.

No published trial located for this entry has tested it for facial appearance.
quick.mechanism: It mechanically prevents the jaw dropping open while asleep.
quick.risks: Mouth breathing usually reflects nasal congestion, and reference sources advise treating the cause. Health effects of related mouth taping are described as little researched.
